boq.title: Bill of Quantities
boq.notInitializedHint: Create one to start building the priced breakdown for this project.
boq.initializeFailed: Could not create the Bill of Quantities.
boq.loadFailed: Could not load the Bill of Quantities.
boq.empty: This version has no items yet.
boq.emptyDraftHint: Add the first section to begin.
boq.emptyBaselinedHint: This version was baselined without any items.

versionActions.failed: That action could not be completed.
versionActions.confirmBaseline: The draft becomes the approved Bill of Quantities. The current approved version is superseded. Editing continues only in a new revision.
versionActions.confirmFirstBaseline: This is the first baseline, so it also becomes the original contract Bill of Quantities. That reference is permanent and every later revision is measured against it.
versionActions.confirmBaselineEmpty: This draft has no items. Baselining it will approve an empty Bill of Quantities.
versionActions.confirmCancelDraft: Every change made in this draft is lost. The approved version is not affected. This cannot be undone.
versionActions.confirmCreateDraft: A new draft is created with a copy of every item in the approved version. The approved version stays in force until the new draft is baselined.
versionActions.notesHint: Optional. Explains why the revision was raised — for example a variation order reference.
